Session date: 3:09 pm on 15 September, 2023
[D28:1] Deborah: Since speaking last, I reconnected with my mom's old friends. Their stories made me tear up and reminded me how lucky I am to have had her.

Session date: 9:48 am on 4 February, 2023
[D4:33] Jolene: Here's a picture I took on vacation last summer in Bogota. It was so beautiful and calming watching the sunset over the water. It definitely made me appreciate nature's calming power.
[D4:34] Deborah: That sounds great, Jolene. Nature's calming for sure. Guess it helps us forget the daily craziness and find inner peace. No wonder you're a fan! I like to come to this spot by the water near my mom's old house. It's where I reflect on her life and find some peace. Being surrounded by nature helps a lot.
[D4:35] Jolene: That's so touching! Do you have any little traditions that you do when you come to reflect on your mom?
[D4:36] Deborah: Do you remember this amulet from her? Whenever I come here, I bring it with me. It's how I feel her love and stay close to her. Holding it brings me comfort.
[D4:37] Jolene: It's amazing how something so small can have such a big impact, huh?
[D4:38] Deborah: Yeah, even small things like this can make a big difference. It's a reminder of all the love and strength we have inside, connecting us to people we've lost and comforting us.
[D4:39] Jolene: It can keep them close in our hearts every day.
[D4:40] Deborah: Anna also has a pendant that she wears in memory of her mother! This also brought us closer.
[D4:41] Jolene: It's nice to have those reminders as a source of strength when we need it.
